implementation: Added a token-authenticated Unix-socket G3 server and TaskMailbox adapter consuming only public TaskRepository message/run/delivery APIs and the existing G3 DeliveryLedger.
Persisted Task/revision/run/message linkage, stable logical message IDs, distinct append-only delivery attempt IDs, role/kind direction, and matching answer/report reply linkage.

Required current role/session generation plus idle, no pending work, no approval, known-empty composer, zero in-flight tools and unpaused state before API injection; the extension repeats fail-closed checks immediately before sendUserMessage.

Separated API return from exact provider-request identity, provider response and same-session agent_end evidence. Unknown/async errors and lost ACKs persist as unknown without automatic replay; process-owned handles reject delivery after mailbox reopen.
Added metadata-only G3 processing/unknown events; no model/user content is emitted through those events. Socket cleanup only unlinks the same socket inode created by this server.

checks.summary: 10 deterministic mailbox tests: directions/reply links, readiness blockers, generation mismatch, API-vs-processing, async error, lost ACK/no replay, reopen rejection, and dedupe.

34 Node G3 and shared contract compatibility tests.

Actual manager+worker OMP 18.2.10 TUI runtime: task/question/answer/report each observed as omp_processed; exact provider identity and role routing; same-handle duplicate suppressed; bounded cleanup left no children, cwd processes, provider threads or bridge socket. Full sanitized runtime data is referenced above.

iteration_notes: The first deterministic run had 7 passes and two fixture errors caused by looking for a delivery request before invoking deliver(); corrected the fixture and final bridge suite passes 10/10.
The first actual runtime processed all four kinds but exposed a leftover Unix socket path; server cleanup was corrected with device/inode validation and the final rerun exited 0.
remaining_gaps: Root owns graphify update, independent fresh review/test integration and final combined-candidate verification.
No CW-10/CW-15 orchestration or process-restart recovery loop was added; persisted messages deliberately do not replay on mailbox reopen.
